'''October 2001 Lompoc tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Lompoc on 13 October 2001. [[Dunya Ertan]] won it. It is known from Dunya Ertan's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3053">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-14-home-of-the-surf-time-usa-lompoc-10-1301d3053/ home-of-the-surf-time-usa-lompoc-10-1301], DeckTech (Dunya "Hardpack" Ertan, 14 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-14-home-of-the-surf-time-usa-lompoc-10-1301d3053/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 13 October 2001
* '''Site:''' Lompoc
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Dunya Ertan]]
